key_facts: Root cause: req() fallback was '[Заполнить]' — literal brackets rendered in Typst output
Root cause: body text from AI was inserted raw into Typst without escaping special chars ([ ] # * _ ~ < > \)
Fix 1: req() fallback changed from '[Заполнить]' to 'Заполнить' (no brackets)
Fix 2: escapeTypst() function added to index.ts — escapes all Typst content-mode special chars
Fix 3: Both official.ts and standard.ts now call escapeTypst() on body paragraphs before insertion
blast_radius: packages/backend/src/templates/official.ts (import escapeTypst, changed req fallback, escaped body)
packages/backend/src/templates/standard.ts (import escapeTypst, changed req fallback, escaped body)

data.for_teamlead: ✅ DONE — Typst bracket leak fixed. Three changes: (1) escapeTypst() in index.ts escapes all Typst content-mode special chars, (2) req() fallback no longer uses brackets, (3) both templates escape body text before insertion. Typecheck passes clean. Templates now produce Typst that compiles without syntax artifacts.
